description_ja: パソコンの前で作業している人物、画面にAIが文章を生成している様子、モダン・クリーンな雰囲気、白背景・青緑系アクセント
prompt_en: A person working at a laptop in a minimalist modern workspace, the screen glowing with AI-generated text flowing across it, soft natural lighting from the side, white background, blue-green accent colors on the screen and desk accessories, photorealistic, high quality, if any text appears use Japanese characters

description_ja: 3つのファイルがAIに入力されて記事と画像が出てくるフロー図、白背景・青緑系・クリーン
prompt_en: A clean flow diagram on white background showing three document icons on the left feeding into a central glowing AI brain icon, with a finished article and image icons emerging on the right, connected by smooth blue-green arrows, soft shadows, minimalist photorealistic style, blue-green color palette, high quality, if any text appears use Japanese characters

description_ja: 3つのツールがパズルのピースのように連携している様子、白背景・青緑系・写真調
prompt_en: Three interlocking puzzle pieces fitting together perfectly on a white background, each piece glowing softly in blue-green tones representing different AI tools working in harmony, clean shadows, minimalist photorealistic style, consistent blue-green color palette, high quality, if any text appears use Japanese characters

description_ja: 二段階AIフロー、情報→指示書→記事の流れ、白背景・青緑系・クリーンな図解
prompt_en: A two-stage flow diagram on white background showing raw information icons on the left flowing into a structured document icon in the center, then into a polished finished article on the right, smooth blue-green arrows connecting each stage, soft clean shadows, minimalist photorealistic style, blue-green color palette, high quality, if any text appears use Japanese characters

description_ja: 時計とカレンダーのビフォーアフター、2〜3時間から30分への変化、白背景・青緑系・写真調
prompt_en: A before and after comparison on white background, left side showing a heavy analog clock with a tired overwhelmed atmosphere in muted tones, right side showing a light minimal clock face with a fresh energetic atmosphere in blue-green tones, a clean arrow pointing from left to right in the center, photorealistic, consistent blue-green color palette, high quality, if any text appears use Japanese characters
